_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the integrity judge returned them, round 3 (the cap); each why abridged by the run.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark register on most frames; kit primitives and grey middles: the cover's blocks, 3's mid-grey tread, 4's mannequin at another depth, 5's flat band, 7's noise strata, 8 a bar chart, 9's dead band.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world; the motif changes state; the reliefs strobe from world to diagram three times.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; the cover drops c7's modal; slide 4 joins c19's pipes and c26's columns with 'that pipe'; slide 3's picture labels six floor plates 'elsewhere'; c3 not listed in the first comment.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Clear what, who, when; safety concrete; nothing to act on.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover, 2, 3 pay; 6 turns; 5 repeats; 7 a tangent; the close never returns to safety.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Good opener; attribution-heavy deks with encoding disclaimers.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Lateral, racks and gate repeat no. 68 in the same basin; floodlit repeats no. 67.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grey noise strata; dot rig; thin string.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Near-black strata, a low rake so only the groove and string catch an edge, a lit mast silhouette.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A bar chart; weak casts; flat bands.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Higher relief, a 15 degree key, box ends at the left with raised rings.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequin at a different depth from the stands.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The person at the stand's base by the slips, side-lit, the cabin deleted.
Draw the six as a different surface off the floor, the pool only on the tread.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Rack in the bottom quarter; dead band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower and push the camera so the ten banded joints fill the middle third.
Die pads, loom, grime, a mill-scale pipe with a hardband ring.
